mapper.select: SELECT m.map_id, m.map_name, m.image_type, m.sort_order, m.del_yn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_graphic_map_door d WHERE d.map_id = m.map_id) AS door_count FROM tb_graphic_map m WHERE m.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.map_id
SELECT map_id, map_name, image_type, sort_order, del_yn FROM tb_graphic_map WHERE map_id = #{mapId}
SELECT map_id, image_data, image_type FROM tb_graphic_map WHERE map_id = #{mapId} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_graphic_map (map_name, image_data, image_type, sort_order) VALUES (#{mapName}, #{imageData}, #{imageType}, (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM tb_graphic_map))
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_graphic_map SET map_name = #{mapName}, mod_dt = getdate() WHERE map_id = #{mapId}
UPDATE tb_graphic_map SET image_data = #{imageData}, image_type = #{imageType}, mod_dt = getdate() WHERE map_id = #{mapId}
UPDATE tb_graphic_map SET del_yn = 'Y', mod_dt = getdate() WHERE map_id = #{mapId}
